[dārīg] az ān ī [az mar ī] yazdānbānag zād [xrad-windād ōstāndār] ō bun ēn māh Ardwahišt ī sāl 36 uzēnīd ī dūdag ī ōstāndār rāy čiyōn pad bun ī Wahman-Ohrmazd ī pad Namēwar dārīg nibištan ud āmār pad-iš kardan abāyēd may 10 sabōy ō Wahman-Ohrmazd dād ud az Wahman-Ohrmazd pad gugāy-muhrān ī awetwārān padīrāy pad-iš stad čak Dēnabzūd āwišt
target_text: [wnd?/ Personal name], [storekeeper/warehouse-keeper] in [placename], from that which (belongs) to the bun, from the yazdānbānag zād[xradwindād ōstāndār] (governor) [account], this month Ardwahišt (2nd month) of the year 36, for (rāy line 4) the expense of the ōstāndār’s family, as (it) must be written under the responsibility of Wahman- Ohrmazd who is a storekeeper/warehouse-keeper in Namēwar and making a reckoning over it, gave Wahman- Ohrmazd 10 ewers (sabōy) of wine, and took a receipt sealed by the trustees’/reliable witnesses' seals for it from Wahman- Ohrmazd. Dēnabzūd sealed the check.

uncertainty.detail: The personal name, locality and administrative title at the opening are missing/restored. PDF8 commentary explicitly reconstructs the opening. Preserve brackets and ellipses; do not assign the giver role to the later sealer.
Main transcription line8 prints awetwārān; commentary discusses awestwārān. The transcription is not silently corrected.

notes: Complete wine-transfer and receipt predicate scope. The damaged opening agent is not supplied; the known recipient must not be relabeled as giver.
Published check is retained rather than replaced with the knowledge-base paraphrase document. Same formula also ends Berk.11; not a second lexical discovery.

source_lines: Zādōy ī pad xīr ī deh dārīg
rōzīg ī kardan ī bāγbānīh ī pad bāγ
Day pad Ādur frāz tā māh
source_text: Zādōy ī pad xīr ī deh dārīg rōzīg ī kardan ī bāγbānīh ī pad bāγ ī Kard-ābād-yazdbād az māh Ardwahišt ī sāl 40 ud rōz Day pad Ādur frāz tā māh Amurdād-ē nazdist ud rōz Ohrmazd pad 2 māh ud 22 rōz gandum grīw 8 kabīz 2 ō ... ī bāγbān(?) dād
target_text: Zādōy, who is the storekeeper/warehouse-keeper of the property of the village, for carrying out the gardening work in the garden of Kard-ābād-yazdbād, from the month Ardwahišt (2nd month) of the year 40 and the day Day pad Ādur (8th day) until the beginning of the month Amurdād (5th month) and the day Ohrmazd (1st day), for two months and 22 days, gave 8 grīw and 2 kabīz of wheat to …, the gardener.

uncertainty.detail: Source line9 bāγbān(?) remains tentative; footnote23 calls the name uncertain and the gardener reading non-final. The English target lacks a corresponding question mark; the full block stays held.

Weber et al.2008 reading kōdak ī bāyāspānīh / bay and the marriage-related German rendering are a separate prior edition. Asefi proposes kardan ī bāγbānīh / bāγ and the place name Kard-ābād-yazdbād. Do not merge the alternative readings into a single certain target.

notes: Complete temporal modifier; no gardening, recipient or payment assertion is inferred from it. Calendar ordinal explanations are the editor’s explicit target annotations; no CE date is generated.

source_lines: ān ī-š az mar ī Yazdānbānag
source_text: Dādēnwindād ī pad Yazdānābestān bunbān az ān ī-š az mar ī Yazdānbānag ōstāndār ō bun rōzīg ī xar 4 ī az mar ī ōstāndār ud pad Yazdānābestān estēnd pānzdahrōzag ī az ēn māh Ādur abar sāl 39 ud rōz Tīr frāz har rōz jud jud kabīz 2 ud 2 gird rāy jaw grīw 12 aspast 120 gird kāh 2 paymān ō Gušnasp ī uštarīgān dād ud pad gugāymuhrīhā ī awestwārān padīrāy pad-iš stad čak Dēnabzūd āwišt
target_text: Dādēnwindād, the bunbān of Yazdānābestān, from what belongs to bun from the account of the governor protected by divine beings (=Yazdānbānag), for the ration of four donkeys, which belong to the governor and are in Yazdānābestan, For fifteen days, starting from the day Tīr onward, in this month Ādur (9th month) in the year 39, and for each day, separately (for each donkey), two kabīz and two bundles, (totally) twelve kabīz of barley and one hundred and twenty bundles of lucerne, two paymān of straw, gave Gušnasp, the camel-driver. And for that received a receipt sealed by trustees’ / witness’s seals. Dēnabzūd sealed the check.

uncertainty.detail: Line13 transcription jaw grīw12 versus target twelve kabīz of barley. PDF21 commentary explicitly gives12grīw=120kabīz under its local conversion and ration calculation. The original English is retained, not repaired.
Asefi revises the earlier readings to ī-š, four donkeys and estēnd, and supplies Dēnabzūd as the sealer. These remain attributed edition readings; no independent manuscript decipherment is claimed.

qualified_scopes.source_text: ud pad gugāymuhrīhā ī awestwārān padīrāy pad-iš stad
qualified_scopes.target_text: And for that received a receipt sealed by trustees’ / witness’s seals.
notes: No barley unit, quantity or donor is reconstructed. That is an anaphoric reference to the held transaction; retained as context dependence. The following Dēnabzūd sealing formula is excluded from this scope because archive57 already contains it; it survives in the full parent.

excluded_duplicate_parent_context.reason: Retained as parent provenance only; no additional repeated seal example.

6. abespārd estēd pānzdah-rōzag
7. rāy az rōz Ohrmazd frāz gandum grīw 1

source_lines: bunbān az ān ī az mar ī farroxtar
ōstāndār ō bun ēn māh Wahman
rāy az rōz Ohrmazd frāz gandum grīw 1
kabīz 5 ud jaw grīw 3 ō Asmāndād
source_text: Dādēnwindād ī pad Yazdānābestān bunbān az ān ī az mar ī farroxtar ōstāndār ō bun ēn māh Wahman ī sāl 41 rōzīg ī Asmāndād ud xar 4 ī ō Asmāndād abespārd estēd pānzdah-rōzag rāy az rōz Ohrmazd frāz gandum grīw 1 kabīz 5 ud jaw grīw 3 ō Asmāndād dād čak Yazdānp…dār(?) āwišt
target_text: Dādēnwindād, the storekeeper/ warehouse-keeper in Yazdānābestān, from the account of the fortunate governor to bun, in this month of Wahman (11th month), year 41, for the ration of Asmāndād and the four donkeys entrusted to Asmāndād, for fifteen days, starting from the day Ohrmazd onward, gave 1 grīw and 5 kabīz of wheat and 3 grīw of barley to Asmāndād. Yazdānp…dār sealed the čak.

uncertainty.detail: Line5 printed Aramaic transliteration ḤMRʼ III versus MP transcription xar4 and English four donkeys. No selection of3or4 as certain is made.
Source Yazdānp…dār(?) is incomplete and uncertain; target lacks the question mark. Commentary says letters are unclear and the expected letters are not visible. Entire closing seal clause stays held.

Asefi revises Gignoux’s Asmānzādān to Asmāndād. Commentary says the final letter most likely represents a stroke. The quantity-transfer scope is retained separately as restricted pending adjudication, without claiming an uncontested name.

qualified_scopes.source_text: pānzdah-rōzag rāy az rōz Ohrmazd frāz
qualified_scopes.target_text: for fifteen days, starting from the day Ohrmazd onward
notes: Complete period/start-day phrase; excludes the disputed donkey count, proposed personal name, and uncertain sealer. It does not assert an independently complete transaction.

qualified_scopes.source_text: gandum grīw 1 kabīz 5 ud jaw grīw 3 ō Asmāndād dād
qualified_scopes.target_text: gave 1 grīw and 5 kabīz of wheat and 3 grīw of barley to Asmāndād.
notes: Amounts and target correspond and avoid the donkey numeral, but Asmāndād is a revised reading justified with most likely in commentary. Not counted among clear scopes before independent adjudication.
